comment: AryC is a Cytochrome P450 monooxygenase responsible for the C-C biaryl bond formation in arylomycins.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 added organic cofactor.

reactions.description: AryC catalyzes C-C biaryl bond formation resulting in Arylomycin A2.
AryC enzymatic cross-coupling establishes the biaryl bond formation without the requirement of attaching precursor peptide substrates to PCP- or PCP-X interaction partners.

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
